title: GeoQuads — Daily
spoiler: Think languages, roads, money and governments.
help: Find the 4 hidden categories. Each has 4 unique items.

groups.name: Portuguese is an official language
groups.fact: Portuguese is an official language on four continents.

groups.name: Drive on the left
groups.fact: Japan and Thailand are the famous exceptions: most left-driving countries were once British-ruled.

groups.name: Use the euro but are not in the EU
groups.fact: Montenegro adopted the euro on its own, without joining the eurozone.

groups.name: Government sits outside the official capital
groups.fact: In the Netherlands, Amsterdam is the capital but the government sits in The Hague.
